description: A VALID eleven-digit account filter that matches NOTHING: the empty result, and the WS-ERROR-MSG DOUBLE-WRITE that goes with it. Of the twenty COCRDLIC cases this is the only one whose surviving error line is the 88-level WS-NO-RECORDS-FOUND text 'NO RECORDS FOUND FOR THIS SEARCH CONDITION.' declared at :121-122, and it exists to pin an INTRA-ARM ORDERING fact (gate G30) that no other case can reach: inside the single DFHRESP(ENDFILE) arm at :1233-1245 the guarded MOVE 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW' at :1238-1240 happens FIRST and is then OVERWRITTEN by SET WS-NO-RECORDS-FOUND at :1244. Hoisting the 88 set above the MOVE, or reordering the two, changes the text the operator reads while leaving every other observable untouched. case04 is the deliberate contrast: it reaches the same arm with a row already placed, so :1241-1242 is false and 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW' survives. INBOUND. EIBCALEN is 160 and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is 'COCRDLIC', so the fresh-start INITIALIZE at :335-341 is skipped and 2000-RECEIVE-MAP runs (:356-362); the AID is DFHENTER, which CSSTRPFY's ladder maps to CCARD-AID-ENTER and which :404-411 accepts as PFK-VALID. The 58-byte WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA cursor (:229-248) arrives holding exactly what INITIALIZE plus SET CA-FIRST-PAGE plus SET CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN leave: WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM 1, WS-CA-LAST-PAGE-DISPLAYED 9, both card-number spans SPACE-filled and both account-id spans zero. Because the AID is not PF08, :415-419 re-asserts CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN. Arms one to seven of the :418-583 EVALUATE all fail - I-SELECTED is zero, so neither ENTER-and-view (:517-540) nor ENTER-and-update (:545-568) matches - so control reaches WHEN OTHER at :572-582, which moves WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM into WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM and browses forward. THE EDITS. 2100-RECEIVE-SCREEN moves ACCTSIDI into CC-ACCT-ID and CARDSIDI into CC-CARD-NUM at :969-970. 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT (:1003-1032) then reads BOTH HALVES OF ONE REDEFINES PAIR in a single condition (gate G34): the not-supplied guard at :1007-1009 tests CC-ACCT-ID as X(11) against LOW-VALUES and SPACES and CC-ACCT-ID-N as 9(11) against ZEROS over the one backing span app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy declares, and all three terms are false for '00000000099'. IS NOT NUMERIC is false too, so the ELSE runs: MOVE CC-ACCT-ID TO CDEMO-ACCT-ID - the X(11) alias, never the numeric one - and SET FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID. The filter is therefore VALID, INPUT-ERROR is never raised, and there is NO CSSETATY DFHRED-plus-asterisk highlight anywhere on this screen (gate G38); case12 is the invalid-filter contrast. 2220-EDIT-CARD (:1036-1069) sees a blank card filter, so it sets FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK, moves ZEROES to CDEMO-CARD-NUM and takes the forward early exit GO TO 2220-EDIT-CARD-EXIT, restructured as a plain return under rule R7. 2250-EDIT-ARRAY (:1073-1119) finds INPUT-ERROR false, tallies zero 'S' and 'U' through the INSPECT at :1079-1082, and takes WHEN SELECT-BLANK CONTINUE on all seven passes of the PERFORM VARYING bounded by 7. WHY THE FILTER MATCHES NOTHING. MEASURED FACT, not an assumption: in app/data/ASCII/carddata.txt - copied byte-for-byte to src/test/resources/fixtures/carddata.txt - the card-to-account relationship is EXACTLY 1:1. All fifty rows carry fifty DISTINCT accounts, 00000000001 through 00000000050, one card each. An eleven-digit numeric id outside that range therefore cannot match, and 00000000099 is the one chosen. An in-range id is a different scenario and belongs to case20, which matches exactly one row. THE BROWSE. 9000-READ-FORWARD (:1123-1262) first wipes the row table with MOVE LOW-VALUES TO WS-ALL-ROWS at :1124 - that is the row table and NOT the browse key, a distinction this case depends on - then STARTBR ... GTEQ at :1129-1136 on the space-filled key just moved in. Spaces collate below every US-ASCII digit, so GTEQ positions before the first record and the READNEXT loop at :1146 walks all FIFTY rows. Each one runs 9500-FILTER-RECORDS (:1382-1409), where FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID is true and CARD-ACCT-ID never equals CC-ACCT-ID, so every record takes SET WS-EXCLUDE-THIS-RECORD followed by GO TO 9500-FILTER-RECORDS-EXIT - the second forward early exit, also a plain return under R7. WS-SCRN-COUNTER consequently never leaves zero: the first-key capture guarded by IF WS-SCRN-COUNTER = 1 at :1173 never fires, the page-full test at :1191 never fires, and so the look-ahead READNEXT at :1197 NEVER EXECUTES on this path. The fifty-first read returns ENDFILE (gate G47, the frozen common/FileStatus token) and takes :1233-1245: SET READ-LOOP-EXIT, SET CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS which is LOW-VALUES, then :1236-1237 stores CARD-ACCT-ID and CARD-NUM into WS-CA-LAST-CARD-ACCT-ID and WS-CA-LAST-CARD-NUM. A read that ended the file returned no record, so CARD-RECORD still holds the FIFTIETH row - 9805583408996588 for account 00000000040 - and the last-key pair is written FROM A RECORD THE FILTER EXCLUDED. That is preserved as found (practice B5), not tidied. WS-ERROR-MSG-OFF is still true, so 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW' lands at :1239; :1241-1242 then finds WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM = 1 AND WS-SCRN-COUNTER = 0 both true and :1244 overwrites it with the 88 value. ENDBR closes the browse at :1258. THE MESSAGE. 1400-SETUP-MESSAGE (:897-923) is walked in SOURCE ORDER: arms one and two need a NOT-OK filter and this one is ISVALID; arm three needs PF07 and arm four and arm five need PF08; so the winner is arm six, WHEN WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE, which is true because 1100-SCREEN-INIT set WS-INFO-MSG to the first VALUE of that condition name, SPACES. It executes SET WS-INFORM-REC-ACTIONS, and neither the CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS arm nor WHEN OTHER is reached. :924 then moves WS-ERROR-MSG, a PIC X(75), into ERRMSGO, a PIC X(78): the 43-character text is space-padded to 75 inside the sending item and the move right-pads three more, so ERRMSGO is the text followed by exactly 35 spaces. The trailing guard at :926-931, IF NOT WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE AND NOT WS-NO-RECORDS-FOUND, is then FALSE precisely BECAUSE WS-NO-RECORDS-FOUND is now true - so INFOMSGO and INFOMSGC are NOT rewritten here. INFOMSGO keeps the 45 SPACES 1100-SCREEN-INIT put in it and INFOMSGC keeps the DFHBMDAR that :671 put there; DFHNEUTR never reaches it. Spaces and LOW-VALUES are held strictly apart throughout (practice B8): the info line is SPACE-filled while every detail row is LOW-VALUE-filled, and conflating the two would fail the field-by-field diff. THE PAINT. 1100-SCREEN-INIT (:642-672) starts from MOVE LOW-VALUES TO CCRDLIAO, so every item it does not write stays binary zero. It writes CCDA-TITLE01 and the ACTIVE CCDA-TITLE02 from line 22 of app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy, LIT-THISTRANID 'CCLI', LIT-THISPGM 'COCRDLIC', the pinned clock as 07/19/22 and 23:12:34, and WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM as PAGENOO - a PIC 9(1) into a PIC X(3), which is an alphanumeric move, so '1' is left-justified and space-padded to '1  '. 1200-SCREEN-ARRAY-INIT (:678-745) guards each row with IF WS-EACH-CARD(n) EQUAL LOW-VALUES and takes CONTINUE seven times, because :1124 emptied WS-ALL-ROWS and nothing refilled it; so CRDSEL1O through CRDSTS7O are ALL LOW-VALUES, and CRDSTP2O through CRDSTP7O are LOW-VALUES because no paragraph in the program writes a stopper item at all (B5). 1250-SETUP-ARRAY-ATTRIBS (:748-834) sends every row down its LOW-VALUES branch, where ROW ONE RECEIVES DFHBMPRF at :753 and ROWS TWO THROUGH SEVEN RECEIVE DFHBMPRO at :766, :778, :790, :801, :813 and :824 - a genuine source asymmetry, preserved and recorded rather than harmonised (B5). Those bytes target CRDSELnA OF CCRDLIAI, the attribute view of the INPUT group's flag byte, which is not one of the output group's C/P/H/V items and so has no home in the attributes map; the parity class asserts them directly instead. 1300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS (:837-890) finds its guard false - EIBCALEN is not zero and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is COCRDLIC, not LIT-MENUPGM - and takes the first arm of the account EVALUATE, WHEN FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID at :845-848: MOVE CC-ACCT-ID TO ACCTSIDO and MOVE DFHBMFSE TO ACCTSIDA, so the operator sees the filter that found nothing still standing in the field. The CDEMO-ACCT-ID variant at :852-853 is NOT taken. The card EVALUATE falls to WHEN CDEMO-CARD-NUM = 0, because 2220-EDIT-CARD zeroed it, so CARDSIDO is MOVE LOW-VALUES. No DFHRED is moved anywhere, and INPUT-OK puts the cursor at ACCTSIDL via MOVE -1 at :886. THE OUTBOUND CURSOR. Derived and stated here rather than pinned, because the compared navigation image is the shared 160-byte CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and nothing else - COCRDLIC's own extension leaves in the response payload, so pinning a WS-CA item under navigation would assert a field the fingerprint does not carry. On return the 58 bytes hold: WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM 1, WS-CA-LAST-PAGE-DISPLAYED 9, WS-CA-NEXT-PAGE-IND LOW-VALUES from :1235, the last-key pair 9805583408996588 and 00000000040 written by :1236-1237 from the excluded fiftieth record, and the first-key pair unchanged from the space-and-zero state it arrived in, because :1173 never fired. PAGENOO '1  ' is that cursor's one observable echo. GATE RULINGS. G15 and G18: one of twenty, and the diff count must be zero per module. G37 and rule R6: the filter value, the AID and the whole cursor arrive in the payload and leave in it - no server-side session state exists, which is why two calls can never share a browse position. G39: the page bound stays WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES VALUE 7 (:177-178) even though zero rows result; it is behaviour, this case declares no page-size member of any kind, and no configuration seam exists anywhere in the program or the module. G45: the case seeds the single CARDDAT key, and the account filter is applied by the program's own 9500-FILTER-RECORDS loop over the BASE browse, never by switching to the CARDAIX path - LIT-CARD-FILE-ACCT-PATH is declared at :215-217 and referenced by no EXEC CICS in the whole program, which is preserved as found (B5) and is never a second table. G47: the ENDFILE outcome on the main loop, reached after fifty filtered-out reads. G51: CONTROLLER_POJO, so the service logic is reached with no HTTP layer in the path. G19, G21 and implicit requirement I1: every one of the fifty CARDDAT rows is pinned as a whole 150-byte image summed by hand from app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy - CARD-NUM X(16) at 1-16, CARD-ACCT-ID 9(11) at 17-27, CARD-CVV-CD 9(03) at 28-30, CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME X(50) at 31-80, the MISSPELLED CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE X(10) at 81-90 kept exactly as the copybook spells it, CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS X(01) at 91 and FILLER X(59) space-filled at 92-150 - so a codec that dropped the FILLER would fail on record width alone. expectedWrites is empty and the final state is the seed unchanged, which is a POSITIVE assertion that a browse of a KSDS defined with UPDATE(YES) and DELETE(YES) wrote nothing. G32 and G35 DO NOT APPLY: COCRDLIC contains no backward loop-forming GO TO and not one CALL 'CEE3ABD', RETURN-CODE or ABEND, so an empty result does not abend and expectedReturnCode stays 0. RECORDED, NOT FIXED (practice B4). The commented-out MOVE 'NO RECORDS TO SHOW' TO WS-ERROR-MSG at :1243 is dead code and stays a no-op - the text it would have produced is a third string that must never appear. app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy declares SIXTEEN 88-level AID conditions on CCARD-AID X(5) - ENTER, CLEAR, PA1, PA2 and PFK01 through PFK12 - where the technical specification records fifteen; the copybook is the authority and the discrepancy is documented rather than silently corrected. The three XCTL sites at :402, :538 and :566 are the program's only transfers of control and none of them is on this path, which is why nextProgram, nextMapset and nextMap are absent and the termination is RETURN_TRANSID with exactly one send. PROVENANCE (practice B12). Every value in this file is STATICALLY DERIVED and was NEVER CAPTURED FROM A LIVE COBOL RUN - risk R-A, since executing the legacy program is impossible here: no z/OS runtime, the available compiler's indexed file handler is disabled, no CICS emulator exists, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are IBM-supplied and absent from this repository. The sources read, paragraph by paragraph and clause by clause, are app/cbl/COCRDLIC.cbl at :121-122, :969-970, :1003-1032, :1124, :1146, :1233-1245, :1382-1409, :897-931 and :924; the byte layout of app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy; the 45 xxxI items and their PICTURE widths in app/cpy-bms/COCRDLI.CPY with app/bms/COCRDLI.bms; the sixteen commarea items of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy; the REDEFINES pairs of app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy; the title literals of app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy; the AID ladder of app/cpy/CSSTRPFY.cpy; the CARDDAT and CCLI definitions in app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD; and the MEASURED 1:1 account-to-card property of app/data/ASCII/carddata.txt. Widths and offsets are mechanical, never taken from prose, and every record image is US-ASCII. No user rules exist for this project - review_rules returns 'No user rules provided.' - so AAP 0.10.2's enterprise practices govern instead, and B1, B3, B4, B5, B7, B8, B11 and B12 are the ones this file answers to.

fields.ERRMSGO: NO RECORDS FOUND FOR THIS SEARCH CONDITION.
